LanguageData.Grechka_ArchoAcceleration.label: archotech acceleration
LanguageData.Grechka_ArchoAcceleration.description: The archotech emitter field temporarily speeds up movement and work. The effect is sustained while the pawn remains within range of an active device.
LanguageData.Grechka_ArchoSuppression.label: archotech suppression
LanguageData.Grechka_ArchoSuppression.description: The archotech emitter field temporarily slows movement and reduces attack accuracy. The effect fades after leaving its range.
